generation_note: Entirely synthetic; generated independently for skills demonstration. Not actual CoinDCX metrics, customers, or operations.

model_validation.predictive_target: No recorded app activity in subsequent calendar month
model_validation.scope: Synthetic data only; not validated on real customers
model_validation.model: Logistic regression with standard scaling and one-hot encoding

metric_definitions.activation: Among users who signed up in the selected FY, percent with first trade on or before dataset end.
metric_definitions.M1_retention: For signup cohorts with a fully observed subsequent calendar month, share with >=1 recorded app session in month M1.
metric_definitions.FY: Indian financial year, 1 April through 31 March; FY2026-27 data only through 13 Nov 2026.
metric_definitions.trading_volume: Sum of synthetic executed trade notional (INR) during report period.
metric_definitions.fee_revenue: Sum of synthetic trading fees (INR), not profit.
metric_definitions.CAC: Non-organic campaign spend divided by new users acquired in the same FY and channel. Simplified channel-attributed CAC.
metric_definitions.marketing_return_proxy: (68% of attributed trading fee revenue minus marketing spend)/marketing spend, illustrative contribution ratio, not actual ROI.
metric_definitions.churn_model: Logistic regression trained on prior monthly snapshots with following-month activity as outcome; scores anchored to Oct 2026 snapshot.
